summary: Diageo plc filed its preliminary results for fiscal year ended 30 June 2026 via Form 6-K. The filing reports a 2.0% organic net sales decline, a 27.2% drop in reported operating profit due to restructuring and impairment charges, and a $0.9 billion restructuring programme expected to yield $850 million in savings. It mentions ongoing disposals of East Africa Breweries PLC and Royal Challengers Bengaluru, but these are routine portfolio updates. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or strategic review is announced; the filing is an ordinary earnings release.
